text:
maria: Hey folks — PR is ready but I forgot the RFC link so CI/merge is blocked. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/10234. Requesting a quick arch bless so we can schedule a canary.

jon: pinging arch team — this looks like the routing/cache piece we discussed last week. Need the RFC URL + a 1-2 line SLO impact for the merge note.

sam: I can do arch review if you attach a short summary + risks. If it's minor I can sign off.

maria: Summary pasted into the PR: adds per-tenant KV-prefix caching and a routing shim to route requests to pinned shards for private deployments. No API surface change. Expected SLO impact: +~5ms p99 on cold starts for affected paths, negligible steady-state. Mitigations: prewarm and canary rollout. RFC: https://redwood.company/rfcs/tiling-cache-routing-2025 (draft).

leo: quick ask — can you add a compatibility matrix for quantized models + behavior for fallback routing? Also include a canary plan (duration & traffic %).

maria: added compat matrix and a canary plan to the PR description: canary 1% for 3h, metrics: latency p50/p95/p99, error rate, token cost. Also documented kv-eviction semantics. PTAL @sam @jon

arch-bot: Arch review requested by maria. Required reviewers: @sam (architecture), @leo (runtime).

sam: skimmed the RFC and PR — LGTM for architecture with one follow-up: add a short note about the kv-eviction race edge case and file an issue to track. Otherwise good to go.

leo: runtime looked fine, agree with sam on the eviction note. I prefer 3h canary so we get two hourly metric points before broad rollout.

maria: thanks all — updating PR to include the eviction issue link and setting canary to 3h. Will merge after canary completes and the follow-up issue is created. :thumbsup:
